title: Split runtime dependencies from non-runtime tooling
description: Move dependencies only needed for IDE serving, documentation rendering, testing/BDD, training, model registry backends, and optional file-format utilities out of the default Tactus install. Keep the execution runtime dependencies available through a runtime-focused install path for downstream scoring consumers.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Confirmed downstream scoring uses both LangGraphScore and TactusScore. The dependency split must keep Tactus execution runtime support available, while moving IDE, docs, testing, training, registry backends, and optional file-format dependencies behind extras.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Cold-path profiling shows TactusScore registration spends 4.2s locally importing TactusRuntime; runtime.py imports DSPy configuration at module load, which pulls DSPy/LiteLLM before execution. Expanding the dependency split work to make the core runtime import lightweight while preserving agent execution behavior.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Split lightweight model validation/default helpers out of the DSPy package so importing the core runtime no longer initializes DSPy or LiteLLM. Exact runtime-image Tactus score registration improved from 4,218 ms to 625 ms before packaged bytecode; combined refactor plus bytecode measured 194 ms. Validation: python -m pytest tests/unit/test_runtime_import_boundaries.py tests/dspy/test_model_params.py tests/core/test_runtime*.py tests/dspy/test_config.py tests/dspy/test_config_utilities.py tests/dspy/test_config_adapter_fallback.py -q (325 passed).
